reader_note: The value carries the 14-nominee count, the 64%/nine independent share, the three fully independent committees, the separate CEO/Chair roles with Thornton as Lead Independent Director, the 15-to-14 size cut on Earley's retirement, and the Audit and CTC rosters and member determinations. It omits the Finance, Nominating and Governance, and Sustainability, Innovation and Policy rosters and their chairs (W.C. Ford Jr., Kennard, Helman), which the committee pages and director cards state. The two-column cards print both names first and then each card's fields, so the selected 'Committees: N/A' (1261) is Farley's: paired with 'Henry Ford III' (1256) it misstates his committees (his own field, 1266, is Finance; SIP). The Board Committees matrix keeps only its header and 'Chair' cells in the text, and 4535 is a shareholder proponent's account of Earley's past roles.
